title: Standard Store Policy
description: ShopZone's standard policy for most products. 30 days to return unused items in original condition.
conditions: Items must be unused with tags/packaging. No returns on personalized, hygiene, or perishable goods.
process_steps: 1. Login → My Orders → Return Request 2. Select items & reason 3. Get free return label 4. Ship back 5. Refund in 5-7 days

title: Electronics Strict Policy
description: Electronics require all accessories and original box. Strict inspection for damage/misuse.
conditions: Must include charger, cables, manuals, box. No scratches, liquid damage, or account locks.
process_steps: 1. My Orders → Return Electronics 2. Upload unboxing photos 3. Approval within 24hrs 4. Free pickup 5. Full inspection required

title: Fashion Extended Policy
description: Generous 45 days for apparel. Perfect for sizing/fit issues common in clothing.
conditions: Unworn, unwashed, tags attached. No perfume stains. Intimates/swimwear non-returnable unless defective.
process_steps: 1. My Orders → Fashion Return 2. Size exchange option 3. Free return shipping 4. Quick 3-day processing

title: Home & Kitchen Fragile
description: Fragile items like glassware get shorter window due to breakage risk during shipping.
conditions: No cracks/chips. Original packaging critical. Restocking fee for damaged returns.
process_steps: 1. Check packaging guide 2. Use bubble wrap 3. Schedule fragile pickup 4. Inspection for breakage

title: Sports Gear Active
description: Gear tested during workouts? Partial refund based on usage condition.
conditions: Light use OK, heavy wear gets partial credit. Must clean before return.
process_steps: 1. My Orders → Sports Return 2. Upload usage photos 3. Condition assessment 4. Partial/full refund based on inspection

title: Defective/Damaged Only
description: Change of mind returns not accepted - only defective/wrong item returns.
conditions: Damaged, defective, or wrong item only. Change of mind = restocking fee.
process_steps: 1. Photo evidence required 2. Same-day approval 3. Free return shipping 4. Priority processing

title: Quick 3-Day Express
description: VIP customers or urgent needs - fastest return processing.
conditions: Express approval within 4 hours. Same-day pickup available in major cities.
process_steps: 1. Priority Return Request 2. 4hr approval 3. Same-day pickup 4. 48hr refund processing

title: Bulk/Corporate Orders
description: Special policy for businesses buying 5+ items. Simplified bulk returns.
conditions: Minimum 5 items. Commercial invoice required. Bulk pickup scheduling.
process_steps: 1. Corporate Return Portal 2. Bulk item selection 3. Single return label 4. Account credit option

title: Seasonal/Holiday Extended
description: Extended window during festive seasons when delivery delays happen.
conditions: Applies Nov-Dec orders. Regular policy after Jan 15. Great for gifts.
process_steps: 1. Holiday Return Window visible 2. Standard process 3. Gift return without receipt OK

title: Gift Returns Easy
description: No receipt needed. Return gifts within policy window with gift wrapper tag.
conditions: Gift tag/receipt not mandatory. Return to original condition.
process_steps: 1. Gift Return option in My Orders 2. No receipt needed 3. Store credit if payment unknown

title: Final Sale No Return
description: Clearance, final sale items. No returns or exchanges accepted.
conditions: All sales final. No exceptions unless defective on arrival.
process_steps: No returns accepted. Defective items contact support within 48hrs with photos.
